metaRules: A fatal error may be sent from any non-CLOSED connection state when it can be safely constructed; transport close then enters CLOSED.
Transport loss or authorization expiry detaches an OPEN running session atomically from its connection; it does not delete the session or its bounded history.

A reopen_session starts in connection-local NONE and may claim only a globally DETACHED session owned by the authenticated credential. Unknown, wrong-owner, already-attached, ended, or concurrently claimed identifiers fail identically with SESSION_REOPEN_REJECTED.

Exactly one history_begin occurs after session_reopened. Zero or more contiguous history_chunk frames cover [startOffset,endOffset), followed by one history_end with the same endOffset. Live terminal_output begins at that end offset or later and never interleaves with the snapshot.

history_begin with truncated false requires startOffset zero. Every chunk offset equals the preceding chunk end; decoded chunk length advances the offset. Offset overflow, overlap, gap, or mismatched end is OUTPUT_OFFSET_INVALID and fatal.
The agent captures the snapshot end atomically with ownership attachment. Output produced afterward remains bounded and is sent only after history_end.
Explicit close with new_session or user_request destroys that running session and its history. Credential expiry/revocation, process exit, unrecoverable failure, and agent shutdown do the same.
Heartbeat frames do not change session state and are legal only after authentication.
Any message without a matching transition is INVALID_STATE and fatal. Direction is part of the transition key.
